title: Alur Inbound Gudang (PO -> Penerimaan -> Penyimpanan -> Stok)
description: Alur bisnis kritikal Portal Gudang untuk barang masuk: buat Purchase Order (approval), terima barang (Goods Receipt/GRN) yang menambah stok dual-ledger (warehouse_stock + rahaza_material_stock) dan memutakhirkan qty diterima PO, lalu penyimpanan (put-away) memindahkan stok dari lokasi penerimaan ke lokasi simpan.
happy_path_steps: Buat PO: pilih vendor + item material (qty, harga) -> POST /purchase-orders -> status draft.
Ajukan & Setujui PO: POST /submit (pending_approval) lalu POST /approve (approved).
Penerimaan (GRN): POST /receiving (draft) lalu PUT /receiving/{id} status=received -> stok bertambah (dual-ledger) + PO qty_received naik (partially/fully_received).
Penyimpanan (Putaway): POST /putaway (source_stock_id -> target_location) -> stok pindah dari lokasi terima ke lokasi simpan.
